en: The postcard shows a sepia-toned image of a three-story modernist building with large windows, set behind a small garden or park area. The building's facade features signage for what appear to be businesses or stores: 'P. Matiss,' 'VEF,' and 'J. Paulsons.' At the bottom of the postcard, there is clear printed text that identifies the location as Liepāja and a specific building, '15. maija nams.' The style and composition suggest a mid-20th-century photograph.
